baseline_mechanism.description: Reading artifacts through a mutable branch name, or fetching without comparing the pinned commit to the observed post-fetch tip, can silently substitute bytes after branch movement.
baseline_mechanism.fixture: R-PO03-WA-025-001 intentionally gives unrelated branch tip B different bytes from pinned commit A.

change.description: Require a full expected commit, force-fetch the branch into a dedicated tracking ref, compare its before/after and expected/observed object IDs, then read each artifact with git show --no-textconv <expected-commit>:<path> and verify frozen SHA-256 plus byte count.
fail_closed_conditions: manifest path is absolute or traverses a parent
resolved object is not a blob
required branch movement is not observed

disposition_scope: Retain as an independently testable PO03-WA-025 mechanism candidate; coordinator ingestion and independent acceptance remain separate.
